newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Paladin makes A$81.7 mln rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Paladin makes A$81.7 mln rights issue.

text.p: Paladin Commercial Trust said on Thursday it would make a one-for-three renounceable rights issue of partly paid ordinary units to raise A$81.72 million to repay debt following the part acquisition of a Sydney office block.
The trust said it had bought half of the Pacific Power building in Sydney's Elizabeth Street.
"The trust's debt level will be reduced to 13.8 percent of total assets on completion of the rights issue," Paladin said in a statement to the Australian Stock Exchange.
The new units will be issued at a price of $1.08 each, of which 25 cents per unit will be payable on acceptance of the offer. The balance of 83 cents per unit must be paid by December 3, 1997.
Paladin said the issue would be underwritten by HSBC James Capel Australia Ltd.
Paladin units closed up one cent at A$1.13.
